english.title: Act as member of flight crew of non-EASA aircraft registered elsewhere than in the United Kingdom when unlicenced
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as a member of the flight crew of a non-EASA aircraft registered in **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY OUTSIDE THE UNITED KINGDOM..) flying for the purpose of commercial air transport, public transport or aerial work when not the holder of an appropriate licence granted or rendered valid under the law of that country or the State of the operator in the case of an aircraft
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 61(3)(a) and 241(7) of and Part C of Schedule 13 to the Air Navigation Order 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
